# Settings reference

<!-- Generated by `rhiza docs` from the settings definitions. Do not edit. -->

Machine settings live in the root's `rhiza.toml`; project settings live in the project's git config. Read them with `rhiza daemon settings` and write one with `rhiza daemon set`.

## Machine settings

### `rhiza.daemon.paused`

Pause the whole daemon: no project is worked while true.

- Type: boolean
- Default: `false`

### `rhiza.daemon.selfUpdate`

Let the daemon update and restart itself when main has a newer build.

- Type: boolean
- Default: `false`

### `rhiza.daemon.maxRuns`

The most runs the daemon works at once, across all projects.

- Type: whole number
- Default: `2`
- Flag: `rhiza daemon --max-runs` overrides it for a run

### `rhiza.daemon.minFree`

The free disk space below which the daemon starts no run, such as 10G.

- Type: size
- Default: `10G`
- Flag: `rhiza daemon --min-free` overrides it for a run

### `rhiza.daemon.maxLoad`

The 1-minute load per core above which the daemon starts no run until the 5-minute load is back under it; 0 turns it off.

- Type: number
- Default: `3.0`
- Flag: `rhiza daemon --max-load` overrides it for a run

### `rhiza.daemon.minMemory`

The available memory below which the daemon starts no run, such as 2G; 0 turns it off.

- Type: size
- Default: `2G`
- Flag: `rhiza daemon --min-memory` overrides it for a run

### `rhiza.daemon.trimGoCache`

Trim the Go build cache when disk space runs low.

- Type: boolean
- Default: `true`

### `rhiza.daemon.permissionMode`

The permission mode agents run in; unset leaves the agent's own default.

- Type: one word
- Default: unset
- Flag: `rhiza daemon --permission-mode` overrides it for a run

### `rhiza.daemon.usage.session`

The token limit of the usage session window; unset means no known limit, so the window never holds.

- Type: token count
- Default: unset

### `rhiza.daemon.usage.weekly`

The token limit of the usage weekly window; unset means no known limit, so the window never holds.

- Type: token count
- Default: unset

### `rhiza.daemon.usage.reserve`

The percent of a usage limit kept back before the governor holds runs.

- Type: percent, 0 to 100
- Default: `20`

### `rhiza.web.host`

The address the web UI is served on, a literal IP.

- Type: IP address
- Default: `127.0.0.1`

### `rhiza.web.port`

The port the web UI is served on, or off to serve none.

- Type: port or off
- Default: `7787`

### `rhiza.daemon.watchdog.enabled`

Run the watchdog, which nudges and retries stalled agents and commands.

- Type: boolean
- Default: `true`

### `rhiza.daemon.watchdog.agentNudge`

How long an agent may be silent before the watchdog nudges it.

- Type: duration
- Default: `20m`

### `rhiza.daemon.watchdog.agentRetry`

How long an agent may be silent before the watchdog retries its step.

- Type: duration
- Default: `40m`

### `rhiza.daemon.watchdog.commandLimit`

How long a command step may run before the watchdog stops it.

- Type: duration
- Default: `30m`

### `rhiza.daemon.watchdog.waitLimit`

How long a wait step may wait before the watchdog gives up on it.

- Type: duration
- Default: `90m`

### `rhiza.daemon.watchdog.retryBudget`

How many times the watchdog retries a stalled step before it gives up.

- Type: whole number
- Default: `2`

### `rhiza.daemon.watchdog.ciReruns`

How many times the watchdog reruns a failed CI check.

- Type: whole number
- Default: `1`

### `rhiza.daemon.watchdog.pollBehind`

How many daemon polls a run may fall behind before the watchdog acts.

- Type: whole number
- Default: `3`

### `rhiza.daemon.watchdog.fileBugs`

File a bug when the watchdog gives up on a step.

- Type: boolean
- Default: `true`

### `rhiza.daemon.watchdog.autonomousOnly`

Watch only autonomous runs, never ones an owner drives.

- Type: boolean
- Default: `true`


## Project settings

### `rhiza.project.paused`

Pause this project: it is not worked while true.

- Type: boolean
- Default: `false`

### `rhiza.project.maxRuns`

The most runs this project has at once; unset means only the daemon's cap applies.

- Type: whole number
- Default: unset

### `rhiza.eventCommand`

A command run through sh -c for each event; unset means none.

- Type: shell command
- Default: unset

### `rhiza.notifyCommand`

A command run through sh -c to notify the owner; unset means none.

- Type: shell command
- Default: unset

### `rhiza.ship.deployUrl`

The health URL ship-change waits on after a merge; unset means no deploy check.

- Type: http or https URL
- Default: unset

### `rhiza.ship.deployTimeout`

How long ship-change waits for the deploy check, such as 15m.

- Type: duration
- Default: `15m`

### `rhiza.ship.ciWindow`

How many of the latest settled CI runs are checked for flakes when judging CI stability.

- Type: whole number
- Default: `20`

### `rhiza.ship.localGate`

The command ship-change runs in the run's worktree before every push while CI is unstable; unset means none.

- Type: shell command
- Default: unset

### `rhiza.autonomy.plan`

Who plans: auto lets an agent plan a request, owner waits for the owner.

- Type: auto or owner
- Default: `owner`

### `rhiza.autonomy.accept`

Who accepts a change set once its review passed: auto accepts a plan run's change set, owner waits for the owner.

- Type: auto or owner
- Default: `auto`

### `rhiza.autonomy.ship`

Who ships an accepted change set: auto merges it, owner waits for the owner.

- Type: auto or owner
- Default: `auto`

### `rhiza.autonomy.signoff`

Who signs off a shipped change set: auto signs off, owner waits for the owner.

- Type: auto or owner
- Default: `auto`

### `rhiza.project.watchdog.enabled`

Run the watchdog, which nudges and retries stalled agents and commands.

- Type: boolean
- Default: `true`

### `rhiza.project.watchdog.agentNudge`

How long an agent may be silent before the watchdog nudges it.

- Type: duration
- Default: `20m`

### `rhiza.project.watchdog.agentRetry`

How long an agent may be silent before the watchdog retries its step.

- Type: duration
- Default: `40m`

### `rhiza.project.watchdog.commandLimit`

How long a command step may run before the watchdog stops it.

- Type: duration
- Default: `30m`

### `rhiza.project.watchdog.waitLimit`

How long a wait step may wait before the watchdog gives up on it.

- Type: duration
- Default: `90m`

### `rhiza.project.watchdog.retryBudget`

How many times the watchdog retries a stalled step before it gives up.

- Type: whole number
- Default: `2`

### `rhiza.project.watchdog.ciReruns`

How many times the watchdog reruns a failed CI check.

- Type: whole number
- Default: `1`

### `rhiza.project.watchdog.fileBugs`

File a bug when the watchdog gives up on a step.

- Type: boolean
- Default: `true`

### `rhiza.project.watchdog.autonomousOnly`

Watch only autonomous runs, never ones an owner drives.

- Type: boolean
- Default: `true`
